home.heroTitle: Launch your affiliate program and track every commission
home.heroSubtitle: AffiliateOS brings advertisers and affiliates together on one platform: personalised links, reliable tracking, automatic commission calculation and dashboards that read well on mobile and desktop.
home.heroNote: Free to start. No credit card required.
home.valueSubtitle: Three principles that separate the platform from a plain link table.
home.value1Body: Every link carries a unique identifier. Every click is timestamped, tied to its affiliate, program and campaign, then attributed within the cookie window set by the advertiser.
home.value2Body: A click is never counted as a sale. Conversions go through validation, duplicates are blocked by unique reference, and amounts are stored as integers: no floating-point rounding.
home.value3Body: French and English interface, FCFA, EUR or USD currency, payout methods configured per country. An architecture designed for constrained mobile connections.
home.personasSubtitle: Each user gets a workspace built for their role.
home.affiliateBody: Find programs, get your links, track your performance and request your payouts.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to run an affiliate program, from generating the link to paying the commission.
features.trackingBody: Short unique links, complete click recording and documented attribution.
features.commissionsBody: Five payout models and an explicit validation cycle before any payment.
features.paymentsBody: A payment architecture independent of any provider, with balance, threshold and history.
features.aiBody: An assistant, a marketing content generator and an analysis of your performance.
features.adminBody: Program moderation, user management, finance and audit log.
features.apiBody: Integrate AffiliateOS with your store or business tool, using scoped API keys.
features.securityBody: Per-company data isolation, server-side validation and no banking data stored.

tracking.title: Personalised links
tracking.body: A unique identifier per link, tied to the affiliate, the program, the product and the campaign.

tracking.title: UTM parameters
tracking.body: Add your UTMs, create several links for the same product and compare their performance.

tracking.title: Promo codes
tracking.body: Assign promotional codes when the advertiser allows it — useful for audio and social media.

tracking.title: Configurable cookie window
tracking.body: The advertiser sets the attribution duration, in days, for each program.

commissions.title: Fixed commission
commissions.body: A set amount per conversion, whatever the cart value.

commissions.title: Percentage commission
commissions.body: A rate applied to the sale amount, net of tax and shipping.

commissions.title: Recurring commission
commissions.body: Payout across several periods for subscriptions.

commissions.title: Per lead or per action
commissions.body: Reward a sign-up, a quote request or any measurable action.

commissions.title: Validation cycle
commissions.body: Pending, approved, rejected, available, paid, cancelled. No status is skipped without a rule.

commissions.title: Duplicate protection
commissions.body: Every conversion carries a unique reference per program: a replayed webhook does not pay twice.

payments.title: Real-time balance
payments.body: Available balance, pending commissions and history, derived from an accounting ledger.

payments.title: Payout threshold
payments.body: A configurable minimum, per program and per currency.

payments.title: Methods configured per country
payments.body: Mobile Money, bank transfer or international provider, enabled country by country.

payments.title: Receipts
payments.body: Every payout keeps its reference and a downloadable receipt.

ai.title: Assistant
ai.body: Find suitable programs, understand their terms and spot interesting offers.

ai.title: Marketing generator
ai.body: Ad copy, emails, social posts, short scripts and catchy headlines.

ai.title: Performance analysis
ai.body: Detection of conversion drops and improvement suggestions, campaign by campaign.

ai.title: Multi-provider
ai.body: OpenAI, Anthropic or Mistral, with per-plan quotas and a spending cap.

admin.title: Program moderation
admin.body: A program can require administrative approval before publication.

admin.title: Account management
admin.body: Search, advertiser verification and suspension, all traced in an audit log.

admin.title: Financial oversight
admin.body: Transactions, commissions, subscriptions and payout requests in one place.

admin.title: Platform settings
admin.body: Pricing, payout thresholds and moderation rules editable without redeploying.

api.title: Versioned REST
api.body: A documented API under /api/v1, with pagination and explicit error codes.

api.title: Scoped keys
api.body: Hashed API keys with precise permissions, revocable at any time.

api.title: Signed webhooks
api.body: Receive your events and verify their HMAC signature before processing them.

api.title: Sandbox environment
api.body: A test mode separate from production, so you can integrate safely.

security.title: Per-company isolation
security.body: Database-level security policies guarantee that one company never reads another company's data.

security.title: Server-side validation
security.body: No data reaches the database without passing a validation schema.

security.title: No banking data stored
security.body: Never a full card number or a CVV: provider references only.

security.title: Audit log
security.body: Every sensitive action is traced: actor, action, entity, before and after.

howItWorks.trackingTitle: What happens when someone clicks a link
howItWorks.trackingBody: Tracking transparency is what makes a program credible to affiliates.
trackingSteps: The link is identified: affiliate, program, product, campaign and UTM parameters.
The click is recorded with a timestamp and a hashed visitor fingerprint — never a plain IP address.
The advertiser's consent and privacy rules are applied.
The visitor is redirected to the authorised destination.
A later conversion is matched to the click within the attribution window, then awaits validation.

about.title: About AffiliateOS
about.intro: AffiliateOS is a SaaS platform for managing, analysing and optimising affiliate marketing. It serves companies that want to launch their own program and affiliates looking for serious offers to promote.
about.missionBody: Make affiliate marketing reliable and readable. Too many programs run on approximate dashboards, disputed commissions and opaque payments. We are building the infrastructure that lets everyone verify the numbers.

principles.title: No invented data
principles.body: Displayed statistics come from the database. When data does not exist, the screen says so instead of showing a plausible number.

principles.title: A click is not a sale
principles.body: Tracking and billing are separated. A conversion always goes through a validation step.

principles.title: Security before speed
principles.body: Database-level data isolation, server-side validation, no card number stored.

principles.title: Designed for African markets
principles.body: French and English, FCFA, local payout methods, and an interface that stays usable on a constrained mobile connection.

about.statusBody: AffiliateOS is under development, in individually validated steps: analysis and architecture, design, database, authentication, core features, artificial intelligence, payments, administration, testing, then deployment. This page evolves at the same pace as the product.

items.question: How do I create an account?
items.answer: Go to the sign-up page, choose your role — affiliate or advertiser — then confirm your email address with the link you receive.

items.question: Can I be both an affiliate and an advertiser?
items.answer: Yes. The two roles map to separate workspaces, with separated data and independent subscriptions.

items.question: How do I get my affiliate link?
items.answer: From your dashboard, open the program you joined and generate a link. You can create several for the same product, each with its own UTM parameters.

items.question: How long does a click stay attributable?
items.answer: The duration is set by the advertiser for each program, in days. It is shown on the program page before you apply.

items.question: Why do my clicks not turn into sales?
items.answer: A click is never counted as a sale. The conversion must be declared by the advertiser, through their API or a webhook, and then validated.

items.question: What are the commission statuses?
items.answer: Pending, approved, rejected, available, paid, cancelled. A commission becomes available once approved and past the refund window.

items.question: What happens on a refund?
items.answer: The matching commission is cancelled by a counter-entry in the accounting ledger. It is never deleted, which keeps a verifiable trail.

items.question: What is the minimum payout amount?
items.answer: It is defined per program and per currency. The applicable threshold is displayed on your payout screen.

items.question: Which payout methods are available?
items.answer: Enabled methods depend on your country: Mobile Money, bank transfer or international provider. A method is only offered when it is genuinely available for your country.
